description: When you publish your Blazor Wasm app, this package pre-renders and saves the app as static HTML files in your public folder.
releaseNotes:
v.10.0.2-preview.1
- Fix: Resolved an issue where the browser tab title briefly changed and the styles added by "HeadContent" were briefly lost when a pre-rendered page started up.
- Improve: Made each pre-rendered page contain only its own "title" element, so that search engines and link previews see the page title instead of the one in "index.html".
- Fix: Resolved an issue where the last "script" element in the document was removed after the app started.

To see all the change logs, please visit the following URL.
- https://github.com/jsakamoto/BlazorWasmPreRendering.Build/blob/master/RELEASE-NOTES.txt
